messages:
alicia: Proposal — add a lightweight request provenance header + per-route inspect-playback toggle in the Console. Primary goals: make sampled inspect sessions debuggable without storing raw PII, and make sample rates visible in the routing UI.

sam: can you sketch what the header looks like? how do we avoid leaking user identifiers in provenance?

alicia: header example: `X-Request-Provenance: route=payments;sample=0.01;req_id=abc123`
  - `route` = logical route name, `sample` = sampling fraction, `req_id` = ephemeral correlation token (not user id).

yves: prefer `req_id` to be a per-request ephemeral token (32b hex) derived via HMAC(key=route_key, nonce). do not include user identifiers. :thumbsup:

marco: ops question — if we keep sampled payloads for playback, what's TTL and who can access? also cost impact on storage + compute when replaying.

alicia: suggested defaults: sample payload retention = 30 days, inspect-playback allowed only to roles with `inspect:view` (Console RBAC), replay runs in ephemeral sandbox that redacts model outputs by default.

sam: about redaction — we need deterministic pseudonymization for embeddings use-cases (so developer can debug similarity without exposing raw text). propose two modes: `redact` (strip PII), `pseudonymize` (salted HMAC with tenant key).

yves: +1 to tenant-scoped HMAC for pseudonymization. rotation: new key used for new pseudonyms, and we keep mapping only for 24h to support immediate backfills, otherwise irreversible.

alicia: console UX: show per-route sample rate badge next to traffic graphs. toggle `Inspect: On/Off` with a per-route override and canary percentage. default off for prod routes.

marco: quota/cost: when inspect enabled we should meter extra storage and compute as a separate metric so teams understand bill impact. maybe `inspect_token_seconds` or `inspect_storage_bytes`.

alicia: agreed — surface in the route billing tab. also provide a CLI flag to update without Console: `redwoodctl routes update payments --inspect-sample 0.01 --provenance-header true`

sam: edge case: attachments/embeddings in request bodies. need explicit opt-in for storing attachments; attachments default to `meta-only` (filename, size) unless route has `inspect:attachments` permission.

yves: for embeddings we store only vector metadata and pseudonymized text hash. never raw embedding->text mapping in plain.

legal: quick note — retention shorter for EU customers unless customer signs DPA with extended retention. must include ability for subject-access deletion requests to remove sampled records within SLA (48h).

alicia: noted. implementation plan: 1) add provenance header parsing and route metadata 2) Console UI for sample toggle + billing metric 3) backend: sampled queue + redact/pseudo pipeline 4) RBAC + audit logs 5) docs + migration guide.

sam: can we mock end-to-end in staging with a low-traffic route? propose `canary/log-provenance` route with 0.001 sample.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/rolling — window 02:00-04:00 UTC next Wed.

marco: ok, create a small perf budget check for replay flows so we don't block inference SLOs.

alicia: thanks. I'll open the RFC and a Console prototype ticket. tagging @yves @sam for review on the HMAC design and @legal for retention + deletion flow.

sam: thanks — I'll write the HMAC design doc and a proof-of-concept hook into the scrub pipeline.

yves: I'll mock key rotation + pseudonymization code and share a snippet in the RFC.

alicia: great — moving to docs triage. :rocket:
